report.status_line: Habitat nominal with 5 days remaining; water pump and tap pressure issues under investigation after static tank refill.

concerns.title: Water pump behavior change and tap pressure drop
concerns.detail: The crew reported that the water pump began behaving differently yesterday afternoon, creating low pressure that prevents using any tap for long periods of time. The engineering crew asked whether the water pressure issue is linked to the backup generator. Following the static tank refill to Full on 2015-01-17 (1 day ago, reading 13 cm today), water remaining is unknown; a trend needs 2 comparable readings. Water used since refill is estimated at 84.84 L at Arctic analog average (12.12 L/person/day) or 17.5 L at NASA minimum (2.5 L/person/day) for the crew of 7.

concerns.title: Water heater replacement proposed
concerns.detail: Engineering crew member DG has proposed replacing the water heater amidst the ongoing tap pressure and water pump anomalies.

crew_actions: Provide a new total water volume estimate, as remaining volume is unknown following the 2015-01-17 static tank refill.
Troubleshoot the water pump and verify whether backup generator power delivery is causing the pressure drop.
Inspect the water heater and hold replacement until Mission Support provides technical guidance.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve or provide technical guidance on replacing the habitat water heater.
decisions_for_earth.why: The crew proposed replacing the water heater after encountering water pump behavioral changes and tap pressure drops.

report.message_to_earth: Habitability is nominal but the water distribution system is experiencing pressure issues. The water pump began behaving differently yesterday afternoon, causing low water pressure that prevents using any tap for long periods of time. The static tank was refilled to full on 2015-01-17 and measured 13 cm today, 1 day after refill. The crew is troubleshooting pump pressure against the backup generator and has proposed replacing the water heater. Propane is nominal at 36%, and diesel is less than ¾. Mission Control guidance and approval on replacing the water heater is requested by tomorrow morning. Next report tomorrow evening.
